events.body:
# Purpose

Deliver an enterprise-grade **AI Quality Gate** for BLT-Toasty, a distributed, fault-tolerant system that intercepts every pull request at the webhook edge, runs deterministic and AI-powered policy checks, and enforces a hard gate so that **CodeRabbit only triggers on quality-filtered PRs**. The system eliminates \~40% of wasted LLM API spend and maintainer triage time caused by spam, noise, and guideline-violating PRs.

# Phase Breakdown

| Phase | Weeks | Hours | Child Issues |
|-------|-------|-------|--------------|
| Phase 0 — Hygiene & ADRs | 1 | 29 | blt-toasty#19 – blt-toasty#21 |
| Phase 1 — CI Gate Skeleton | 2 | 29 | blt-toasty#22 – blt-toasty#24 |
| Phase 2 — Ingress + Queues | 3–4 | 58 | blt-toasty#25 – blt-toasty#29 |
| Phase 3 — Policy Engine + D1 | 5–6 | 58 | blt-toasty#30 – blt-toasty#34 |
| Phase 4 — AI Layer | 7–9 | 87 | blt-toasty#35 – blt-toasty#41 |
| Phase 5 — Dashboard & Ops | 10–12 | 89 | blt-toasty#42 – blt-toasty#48 |

# Steps

The plan's step issues were not moved one by one; they are tracked here. Each one links back to its GitLab issue (kept read-only in the archived group) for the full description.

- [ ] Docs: Architecture — Write and publish ADR set (ADR-01 through ADR-09) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#20)
- [ ] Docs: Operations — Define SLO sheet and acceptance criteria (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#21)
- [ ] Feature: Webhook Ingress — CF KV idempotency dedup layer (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#26)
- [ ] Feature: Webhook Ingress — CF Queue job enqueue and 202 ACK (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#27)
- [ ] Feature: Gate Processor — CF Queue consumer Worker with retry & DLQ (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#28)
- [ ] Test: Ingress + Queues — Queue reliability integration test suite (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#29)
- [ ] Feature: Database — D1 schema migration and SQL helpers (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#30)
- [ ] Feature: Policy Engine — Deterministic rule framework (`engine.py`) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#31)
- [ ] Feature: Policy Engine — Wire engine into queue consumer and post Check Runs (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#32)
- [ ] Feature: AI Gateway — LiteLLM provider integration in Workers (`providers.py`) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#35)
- [ ] Feature: AI Gateway — Provider fallback chain logic (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#36)
- [ ] Test: AI Gateway — Provider switch integration test matrix (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#37)
- [ ] Feature: BYOK — Key management API Worker (`byok-api`) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#38)
- [ ] Test: BYOK — Security checklist (10/10 controls) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#39)
- [ ] Feature: RAG — Cloudflare Vectorize ingestion pipeline (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#40)
- [ ] Feature: RAG — Vectorize retrieval integration and grounded explanations (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#41)
- [ ] Feature: Dashboard — Cloudflare Pages project scaffold and Decision Feed (Screen 1) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#42)
- [ ] Feature: Dashboard — Decision Trace Detail view (Screen 2) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#43)
- [ ] Feature: Dashboard — BYOK Key Manager UI (Screen 3) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#44)
- [ ] Feature: Dashboard — Cost & Token Analytics view (Screen 4) (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#45)
- [ ] Feature: Observability — Workers Analytics Engine integration (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#46)
- [ ] Feature: Operations — Shadow rollout, tuning, and quality analysis (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#47)
- [ ] Feature: Operations — Hard gate enforcement, launch checklist, and handoff (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-toasty#48)

The GitHub-mirror-only steps (blt-toasty#22, blt-toasty#23, blt-toasty#24, blt-toasty#25, blt-toasty#33, blt-toasty#34: GitHub Actions workflows, Check Runs and branch protection) were dropped, because BLT pull requests now live on the forge, which has neither. The baseline audit (blt-toasty#19) was closed as obsolete.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-toasty/-/issues/18 (opened by @aryanghai1205 on 2026-06-06).

**Discussion summary**

- No gate code has landed; only the README overview (Aryan Ghai, June 2026). The child issues have had no activity since June.
- The AI Quality Gate plan targets the GitHub mirror (Actions, Check Runs, branch protection); BLT pull requests now live on git.owaspblt.org, so the gate needs re-targeting at forge pull requests (a `.forkmesh/` workflow on pull events); this issue tracks that work.
- The GitHub-only children and the baseline audit were closed during the move; the remaining steps were closed in favour of the checklist above.
